strategy: Wait a lunar cycle (28 days) before major decisions
energy: Completely open design that samples the energy of environments and people around them. Rare — 1% of the population. Deeply sensitive to environmental quality.
work_approach: Act as a barometer of collective health. Excel at evaluation, assessment, and creating environments where others can thrive. Need to be very selective about environment and the people around them — they amplify everything.
career_advice: Environment is everything. Prioritise working in places and with people who are healthy and aligned. Do not rush major career decisions — use the full lunar cycle. Roles in evaluation, community building, and quality assessment suit Reflectors.
burnout_signal: Disappointment. From living or working in unhealthy environments, or from making major decisions too quickly.
pitfall: Absorbing others' unhealthy energy, making major decisions too quickly, staying in wrong environments.
